framework_lessons: A profitable business can be an unprofitable purchase.
assessment: The new positions suffered adverse one-year price sensitivities while the sold chip stocks kept rising, although the author explicitly avoided calling tops. PayPal support failed, and Fiserv soon disclosed substantive deterioration. Accenture earnings growth supported the business thesis without producing a positive first-year stock return.
